login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Enter your details to continue.
login.notVerified: Please confirm your email address first. Check your inbox for the link we sent.
login.verificationResent: If a confirmation is pending for this address, a new link is on its way.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Save your documents and pick up where you left off.
signup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords and your email address.
signup.checkEmailBody: If {email} can be used for a new account, we've sent a link to confirm it. Open the link to finish creating your account. It expires in 24 hours.
signup.resent: If a confirmation is pending for this address, a new link is on its way.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password is incorrect.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.weakPassword: Use at least 10 characters, and avoid common passwords or your email address.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailNotVerified: Please confirm your email address first.
errors.emailUnavailable: We can't send email right now. Please try again later.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid, has expired, or was already used.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: Click the button below to confirm your email address and sign in.
verify.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid, has expired, or was already used.
verify.requestNew: Log in to request a new link
verify.missingToken: This page needs the link from your confirmation email.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link. It expires in 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Your new password will sign you out on every other device.
reset.success: Your password has been changed. You can now log in with it.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid, has expired, or was already used.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your JPdf account
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for signing up for JPdf. Confirm your email address to finish creating your account.
verifyEmail.footer: This link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't create a JPdf account, you can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your JPdf password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset the password for your JPdf account.
resetPassword.footer: This link expires in 30 minutes and can be used once. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password won't change.

accountExists.subject: Your JPdf account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to create a new JPdf account with this email address, but you already have one. If it was you, just log in. If you forgot your password, you can reset it.
accountExists.footer: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Nothing has changed on your account.
